_metadata.description: Mature miRNA family sequences (human (hsa)) built from miRBase CURRENT. Family grouping by seed sequence (positions 2-8, canonical functional definition).
_metadata.warning: Generated by scripts/build_mirbase_data.py from miRBase CURRENT. Re-run after each miRBase release update.
_metadata.family_grouping: Seed sequence positions 2-8 (canonical miRNA family definition). Members sharing the same seed are cross-reactivity candidates for the stemloop RT primer overhang region.
_metadata.verification_notes: Verified 2026-07-04 via benchmark/validate_family_grouping.py (13/13 tests, 6/6 integrity checks). Spot-checked 5 major families: let-7 (11 members, all canonical 5p members grouped correctly), miR-200 (split into 5p/3p seed groups as expected), miR-30 (5 members), miR-29 (3 members), miR-200_AAUACUG (3p seed group). High Hamming (max=6) between miR-4458/miR-4500 in let-7 family is expected: seed-based grouping captures functional seed similarity; these members have different 3-prime overhangs so they will NOT cross-react at the stemloop RT primer binding region (Chen 2005). Source: seed-based grouping from miRBase CURRENT (miFam.dat confirmed unavailable from all sources as of 2026-07-04: HTTPS HTTP 500, FTP timeout, EBI FTP 404, Wayback Machine no crawl). Seed-based grouping is the production data source.
